title: Jags' DaVon Hamilton on filling it at long snapper: "You've got to do a job? Get it done"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jags' DaVon Hamilton on filling it at long snapper: "You've got to do a job? Get it done"
sources.description: When Jaguars long snapper Ross Matiscik got hurt on his first snap on Sunday in London, nose tackle DaVon Hamilton filled in.
